sources.title: GitHub - MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3 · GitHub
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 is a general-purpose, omni-modal generative system. It supports unified understanding of multimodal contexts composed of text, images, video, and audio, and can generate video with native stereo audio at resolutions up to 2K and durations of up to 15 seconds.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 LoRA — Categories, Settings & Where to Find Them
sources.snippet: A MiniMax H3 LoRA is a small adapter file loaded on top of the open H3-Base weights. It fine-tunes H3 output toward a specific style, character identity, camera behavior, motion vocabulary, or reduced step count without retraining the full base model.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA: 5× Faster Video Generation Setup Guide
sources.snippet: Install MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA in ComfyUI, choose v4 or v1, wire the sampler, and tune 4-8 step generation for faster video with stereo audio.
